name: wall_left

name: wedge_top
note: tapered wedge under the top: 18 mm sloping panel at the half angle (its face is the horn wall), 18 mm side closures against the side walls and 3 ribs, glued to the flat panel and the baffle front face and sealed; 312 mm deep at the baffle, nothing at the mouth

name: wedge_bottom

name: baffle
note: 25 mm birch rectangle, 480 wide at the front face by 792 high, side edges bevelled 15.0 deg, 353 mm cutout, 8 flange holes on 369 PCD, 4 standoff bolts (one 12 mm duct hole)

name: back
note: 18 mm birch rectangle, removable, 463 x 828 at the front face, side edges bevelled 15.0 deg to continue the walls; 2 mm deep gasket groove; 12 M5 screws into inserts in the wall, top and bottom ends; 64 mm terminal cup
